MG Kraft Paper

Machine Glazed Kraft

MG Kraft paper is a machine glazed coated kraft paper that stands out for high tensile strength owing to a greater paper density. It has a natural brown appearance with a high gloss finish on the top side and is eco friendly. It can be further coated with polymer layers for enhanced performance.

Talk to our team

Applications

  • Food packaging
  • Paper bags
  • Envelopes
  • Box manufacturing

Key Properties

  • High tensile strength
  • Machine glazed finish
  • Natural brown colour & texture
  • High MG gloss on top surface
  • Strong bursting factor (BF)
  • Notable tearing & tensile strength

Specifications

StrengthMeasured by Bursting Factor (BF)
FinishNatural brown, MG gloss top

UncoatedPolymer coatedOptional polymer

MG Kraft Paper is used for food packaging, paper bags, envelopes, box manufacturing.

K P Packaging both manufactures and distributes MG Kraft Paper.
What are the key features of MG Kraft Paper?
High tensile strength; Machine glazed finish; Natural brown colour & texture; High MG gloss on top surface.
